sources.title: GitHub - SYSTRAN/faster-whisper: Faster Whisper transcription with ...
sources.snippet: faster-whisper is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using CTranslate2, which is a fast inference engine for Transformer models. This implementation is up to 4 times faster than openai/whisper for the same accuracy while using less memory. The efficiency can be further improved with 8-bit quantization on both CPU and GPU.
